# C S Rushil & Co.
> C S Rushil & Co. (legal name: C S Rushil & Co, Chartered Accountants) is a chartered accountancy firm
> at Old Door No. AP-890, New No. 18, J-Block, 1st Street, 13th Main Rd, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600040,
> founded in 2024 and led by CA Rushil C S (Certified FAFD, Start-up Mentor) with a 16-member team.
> Services: company, LLP, OPC, partnership and Section 8 registration; GST; income tax and NRI tax;
> statutory, tax and internal audit; ROC, FEMA and annual compliance; accounting outsourcing; virtual CFO.
> Consultations in English, Tamil and Hindi; walk-in office in Anna Nagar and online service across India.

## Company & LLP registration
- [Company Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/company-registration-chennai): Fast-tracked Private Limited and LLP company registration in Chennai, from name approval to certificate of incorporation.
- [Private Limited Company Incorporation](https://www.csrushil.com/private-limited-company-incorporation-chennai): End-to-end SPICe+ incorporation for Private Limited Companies in Chennai — documentation, MCA filing, and post-incorporation compliance.
- [LLP Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/llp-registration-chennai): Limited Liability Partnership registration in Chennai — DPIN, name reservation, FiLLiP filing, and LLP Agreement drafting.
- [OPC Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/opc-registration-chennai): One Person Company registration for solo founders: SPICe+ filing, nominee consent (INC-3), NRI eligibility and later conversion to Pvt Ltd.
- [Partnership Firm Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/partnership-firm-registration-chennai): Partnership deed drafting and stamping, registration with the Tamil Nadu Registrar of Firms on tnreginet, firm PAN, GST and deed changes.
- [Proprietorship Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/proprietorship-registration-chennai): GST, Udyam, Tamil Nadu Shops and Establishments and trade licence for sole proprietors, plus documents for a current account.
- [Section 8 Company Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/section-8-company-registration-chennai): Not-for-profit company registration with the Section 8 licence through SPICe+, objects drafting and 12A/80G (Form 105) next steps.

## India entry (foreign companies)
- [Company Setup in India for Foreign Businesses](https://www.csrushil.com/company-registration-india-for-foreigners): Subsidiary, LLP or branch set-up for foreign companies and founders, with FDI reporting and Tamil Nadu location support.
- [India Subsidiary for US Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-for-us-companies): Indian subsidiary set-up for US parents: apostilled documents, resident director, FDI route, FC-GPR, transfer pricing and US CPA coordination.
- [India Subsidiary for UK Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-for-uk-companies): Indian subsidiary set-up for UK parents: FCDO apostille, resident director, FDI route, FC-GPR, India–UK tax treaty and CETA points.
- [India Subsidiary for Singapore Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-for-singapore-companies): Indian subsidiary set-up for Singapore parents: apostilled documents, resident director, FDI route, FC-GPR and transfer pricing, Indian-law services.
- [India Subsidiary for UAE Companies](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-for-uae-companies): Indian subsidiary set-up for UAE mainland and free-zone parents and NRI founders: MOFA attestation, FDI route, FC-GPR and India–UAE treaties.
- [EOR vs Subsidiary in India](https://www.csrushil.com/eor-vs-subsidiary-india): Compare an Employer of Record with your own Indian subsidiary on control, speed, PE risk, IP and compliance, and plan the move to an entity.
- [India Subsidiary Compliance & CFO](https://www.csrushil.com/india-subsidiary-compliance-cfo): One retainer for audit, ROC, FEMA, transfer pricing, GST, payroll and group reporting for foreign-owned Indian companies.
- [FEMA & RBI Compliance](https://www.csrushil.com/fema-rbi-compliance): FC-GPR, FC-TRS, annual FLA return, ODI and APR filings, and late submission fee regularisation for foreign-invested companies.

## Business licences
- [Startup India (DPIIT) Recognition](https://www.csrushil.com/startup-india-registration-chennai): DPIIT startup recognition through NSWS for companies, LLPs and registered partnerships, plus the Section 140 tax holiday application.
- [MSME / Udyam Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/msme-udyam-registration-chennai): Udyam registration for small and medium enterprises in Chennai, unlocking collateral-free loans and government scheme benefits.
- [Digital Signature Certificate (DSC)](https://www.csrushil.com/digital-signature-certificate-chennai): Class 3 DSC for MCA, GST, income tax, DGFT and e-tenders, issued through licensed Certifying Authorities with Aadhaar eKYC or video verification.
- [Trademark Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/trademark-registration-chennai): Trademark search, Nice class selection, TM-A documentation, objection support and renewal tracking for Chennai brands and startups.
- [IEC Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/iec-registration-chennai): Import Export Code from DGFT for Chennai importers and exporters, with annual April–June updation, modification and GST LUT support.
- [FSSAI Licence & Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/fssai-license-chennai): FSSAI basic registration, state and central licences on FoSCoS under the April 2026 turnover limits, plus modifications and annual returns.

## GST
- [Goods & Services Tax (GST)](https://www.csrushil.com/goods-and-services-tax): GST registration, return filing, amendments, cancellations, notice replies, and LUT applications.
- [GST Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-registration-chennai): New GST registration for businesses and professionals in Chennai — documentation, ARN tracking, and certificate issuance.
- [GST Return Filing](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-chennai): Monthly and quarterly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B, QRMP, CMP-08, GSTR-4 and annual GSTR-9/9C, with GSTR-2B reconciliation before every filing.
- [GST Notice Reply](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-notice-reply-chennai): Replies to ASMT-10, DRC-01A, DRC-01 and audit notices for Tamil Nadu businesses, before a dispute becomes an appeal.
- [GST Litigation & Appeals](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-chennai): Representation for GST show-cause notices, departmental audits, appeals, and GSTAT proceedings for Chennai businesses.
- [GST Returns: GST returns for e-commerce sellers](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-ecommerce-sellers): GST returns for e-commerce sellers: state-wise GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and marketplace settlements matched first
- [GST Returns: GST returns for Amazon sellers](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-amazon-sellers): GST returns for Amazon sellers: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, Amazon TCS and settlements reconciled before each filing
- [GST Returns: GST returns for freelancers](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-freelancers): GST returns for freelancers: registration limits, Indian and overseas invoices, monthly GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
- [GST Returns: GST returns for restaurants](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-restaurants): GST returns for restaurants: composition or regular scheme, delivery platform sales, GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B
- [GST Returns: GST returns for clinics](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-clinics): GST returns for clinics: exempt and taxable services, medicine sales and input credit checked before filing
- [GST Returns: GST returns for startups](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-startups): GST returns for startups: the first return set up correctly, input credit on opening stock, monthly filing
- [GST Returns: GST returns for manufacturers](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-manufacturers): GST returns for manufacturers: input tax credit, inverted duty refunds, job work and GSTR-2B reconciliation
- [GST Returns: GST returns for importers and exporters](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-return-filing-for-import-export-businesses): GST returns for importers and exporters: IGST on imports, LUT for exports, export invoices and refund claims

## Income tax & NRI
- [Direct Tax](https://www.csrushil.com/direct-tax): Income tax planning, return filing, assessments, and representation before tax authorities.
- [Income Tax Consultant for HNIs](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-consultant-for-hni-chennai): Tax planning for HNIs and families in Chennai: capital gains, ESOPs and foreign RSUs, Schedule FA, residency, HUFs and advance tax.
- [Income Tax Return Filing](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-return-filing-chennai): ITR filing for salaried individuals, professionals, and businesses in Chennai, with advance tax and refund tracking.
- [Income Tax Notice Reply](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-notice-reply-chennai): Responses to intimations, defective-return, scrutiny and reassessment notices, including faceless assessment submissions.
- [Income Tax Assessment & Appeals](https://www.csrushil.com/income-tax-assessment-appeals-chennai): Scrutiny and reassessment proceedings, appeals to the CIT(A) and the ITAT, and applications for stay of demand.
- [TDS Return Filing](https://www.csrushil.com/tds-return-filing-chennai): Quarterly TDS statements in Forms 138, 140 and 144 (earlier 24Q, 26Q, 27Q), Form 16/16A certificates, corrections and TDS on rent and property.
- [NRI Tax Services](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services): Indian tax filing, DTAA claims, property-sale TDS and repatriation for NRIs in the UAE, UK, USA and elsewhere — handled remotely from Chennai.
- [NRI Tax Services — UAE](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-uae): Indian ITR, DTAA claims and deemed-residency checks for NRIs living in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the wider UAE.
- [NRI Tax Services — UK](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-uk): Indian tax filing and India–UK DTAA support, with the figures your UK accountant needs for HMRC.
- [NRI Tax Services — USA](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-tax-services-usa): Indian tax filing and India–US DTAA support, with account data for your US CPA’s FBAR and FATCA reporting.
- [NRI Property Sale — TDS & Repatriation](https://www.csrushil.com/nri-property-sale-tds-chennai): Lower-deduction certificates, capital gains, Form 15CA/15CB and repatriation for NRIs selling property in Chennai.
- [Form 15CA & 15CB](https://www.csrushil.com/form-15ca-15cb-chennai): CA certificate and remitter's declaration (now Forms 146 and 145) for payments to non-residents, NRO repatriation and property-sale proceeds.

## Audit
- [Audit & Assurance](https://www.csrushil.com/audit-and-assurance): Statutory, internal, tax, transfer pricing, forensic, and stock audits delivered with independence and rigour.
- [Statutory Audit](https://www.csrushil.com/statutory-audit-chennai): Companies Act statutory audit for Chennai businesses — independent, evidence-based financial statement audit.
- [Tax Audit](https://www.csrushil.com/tax-audit-chennai): Section 44AB tax audit for businesses and professionals in Chennai crossing prescribed turnover limits.
- [Transfer Pricing Audit](https://www.csrushil.com/transfer-pricing-audit): Form 3CEB certification and arm's-length pricing documentation for related-party and cross-border transactions.

## Compliance & accounting
- [ROC Compliances](https://www.csrushil.com/roc-compliances): Annual filings, statutory registers, and Companies Act compliance to keep your company in good standing with the MCA.
- [Annual Compliance Package](https://www.csrushil.com/annual-compliance-package): Bookkeeping, statutory audit, ROC filings, DIR-3 KYC, ITR, GST and TDS returns for companies and LLPs on one calendar.
- [Accounting Outsourcing](https://www.csrushil.com/accounting-outsourcing-chennai): Outsource your whole finance back office in Chennai: bookkeeping, payroll, GST, TDS, PF and ESI filings, monthly MIS and Tally or Zoho Books setup.
- [Bookkeeping Services](https://www.csrushil.com/bookkeeping-services-chennai): Cloud accounting, monthly books close, and MIS reporting on Zoho Books, Tally Prime, QuickBooks, or Xero for Chennai businesses.
- [Payroll Services](https://www.csrushil.com/payroll-services-chennai): End-to-end payroll outsourcing with PF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS compliance for businesses across Chennai.
- [RERA Compliance](https://www.csrushil.com/rera): RERA project registration, quarterly filings, and compliance advisory for real estate developers and agents in Tamil Nadu.
- [Trust & NGO Registration](https://www.csrushil.com/trust): Formation and compliance for trusts, societies, and Section 8 companies, including 12A/80G registration support.
- [Outsourced Accounting for US CPA Firms](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-accounting-for-cpa-firms): Bookkeeping, month-end close and tax-prep support prepared for US CPA review, with Section 7216-aware data handling.
- [Outsourced Bookkeeping for UK Practices](https://www.csrushil.com/outsourced-accounting-for-uk-accountants): Bookkeeping, MTD VAT returns and year-end accounts preparation for UK accountancy practices to review and file.

- [GST Litigation in Coimbatore](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-coimbatore): Notice replies and appeals for pump, motor, foundry and textile machinery units, including the Coimbatore GSTAT bench.
- [GST Litigation in Tiruppur](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-tiruppur): IGST and LUT refund rejections, inverted duty claims and appeals for Tiruppur knitwear exporters.
- [GST Litigation in Madurai](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-madurai): Notice replies and appeals for southern Tamil Nadu traders, granite and agri-linked businesses; Madurai GSTAT bench.
- [GST Litigation in Salem](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-salem): E-way bill detention appeals, GTA disputes and notice replies for Salem steel, sago, textile units and lorry operators.
- [GST Litigation in Trichy](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-tiruchirappalli): Works contract rates, TDS mismatches, blocked ITC and appeals for Trichy engineering units and contractors.
- [GST Litigation in Hosur](https://www.csrushil.com/gst-litigation-hosur): Place-of-supply, wrong-tax-head and inter-state e-way bill disputes for Hosur auto component and electronics makers.
